title: Question 31
passage:
Could we print just one copy to see how the gray looks on this paper?
A. Gray is listed after blue in the catalog. B. All the copies were picked up this morning. C. Yes. I’ll stop the printer after the first sheet.
passageZh:
我們能不能先印一張，看看灰色印在這種紙上的效果？
A. 目錄裡灰色排在藍色後面。 B. 所有印好的份數今天早上都被取走了。 C. 可以。第一張印出來後，我就會停下印表機。
